{"summary":"A single namespace is using all available cluster memory. The provided documentation does not describe symptoms of a memory leak, but it does describe mechanisms to restrict memory usage per namespace (minimum/maximum memory constraints, default memory requests/limits, and memory quotas).","likely_cause":"Unconstrained memory usage in the namespace (e.g., pods without memory limits) leading to excessive consumption, which may appear as a memory leak.","confidence":"low","next_action":"1. Review the namespace's pod specifications for missing memory requests/limits.
2. Apply a Minimum and Maximum Memory Constraint for the namespace (see docs excerpt [1] and [5]).
3. Configure Default Memory Requests and Limits for the namespace (see docs excerpt [2] and [4]).
4. Set a Memory Quota for the namespace to cap total memory usage (see docs excerpt [2] and [5]).
5. After applying constraints, monitor memory consumption to verify the issue is mitigated."}
